letter.delivery: A letter, delivered by a star
letter.title: For you, on your birthday
letter.p1: I wanted to save a little of today's starlight in this letter, just for you. I'm so glad you're here in the world.
letter.p2: This year, there's no hurry to become someone else. I hope you eat well, sleep peacefully, and make time for things that make you happy. When you're tired, it's okay to slow down.
letter.p3: May your small hopes grow into days you love. Happy birthday. When you look back on this year, I hope you'll be fond of the person you were along the way.
